items.note: Hovering the first product card in the 4-column grid lifts its whole outer bordered box up and to the left with a solid ink offset shadow at the lower right, while the other cards sit flush under the yellow shop band. This is the linked-card recipe, and the carried-over major is fixed.

In dark the hovered first card is translated about 4px with a light hard offset shadow along its right and bottom edges, so it stands out from the flush dark cards, and the band, pills and pink price tags read clearly.
In the one-column mobile grid the hovered first card is lifted with the ink offset shadow, and the band has collapsed to the title plus a scrolling pill strip that runs off the edge as the spec asks.

After adding to cart, a raised white toast with an ink border, check icon, 'View cart' link and close button sits bottom-left and the header cart count turns to a pink 1. The pink submit is still lifted, so it is clear what happened and where to go next.
The dark toast is a dark raised card with a light border and a pink check, bottom-left over the sticker image area, its text and underlined link are readable, and the cart badge shows 1.
On mobile the toast spans the bottom of the viewport under the Details list with its hard shadow, check icon, message, 'View cart' link and close button, and it covers nothing the person needs.

The checkout card shows a bordered summary 'Fix the 3 fields marked below.' with an alert icon. Each empty field has a red border and an icon-plus-text message under it, and the first field is focused with the ink border and pink halo, under a periwinkle cart band.

In dark the same error summary, red-bordered fields and red inline messages are readable on the dark raised card, the focused first field shows the pink halo, and there is a single pink 'Place order' button.

On mobile the items card stacks above the checkout card. The summary, three red-outlined fields with their messages and the pink submit sit in one column with nothing clipped, and the first field shows the focus halo.
Keyboard focus is on the 'Cart' nav pill, which gets a clear 2px ink ring next to the ink-filled current 'Shop' pill. It is easy to tell apart from the resting pills and is not a browser default.
In dark the focused 'Cart' pill carries a pink focus ring beside the paper-filled current 'Shop' pill, and it is clearly visible on the near-black header.
On mobile the focused 'Cart' pill in the second header row shows the full ink ring, not clipped, next to the ink 'Shop' pill, above the yellow band and its scrolling category strip.

Eleven product placeholders, each a different sticker object on a band-colour square: tote, backpack, duffel, sweater, tee, coat, mug, pan, towels, key ring and beanie. Each is flat pink, yellow or teal on a heavy ink outline, tilted, with no gradients, and each reads as its item at card size.
The detail image is the tilted pink tote with a periwinkle pocket and a round handle, drawn with a heavy ink outline on a yellow band square. It is clean at the large size and clearly a bag.
The sweater is a pink long-sleeve knit with a teal neckband and hem on a lime square, with a tilted heavy ink outline. It is a different drawing from the tee and reads as a sweater.
The empty-cart sticker is the coin from the recipe: a pink face with a heavy plus glyph, a periwinkle rim offset down-right, and a thick ink outline. It is crisp and readable at its shown size.
